scripts.check: pnpm test && pnpm check:go && pnpm build && pnpm --dir update-worker check
scripts.test: pnpm test:go && pnpm test:web && pnpm test:worker && pnpm test:release
scripts.test:db: node -e "if (!process.env.TEST_DATABASE_URL) { console.error('Set TEST_DATABASE_URL to an isolated PostgreSQL test database'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm test:db && pnpm build && CGO_ENABLED=0 VOICES_BROWSER_TEST=1 E2E_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 go test ./internal/app -run '^(TestAdministrationInsightsBrowser|TestBrowserFullStack|TestAccountsBrowserFullStack|TestInterfaceLanguageBrowser|TestLLMModelsBrowser|TestServerSettingsBrowser|TestUpdatesBrowser|TestOnboardingBrowser)$' -count=1 -v -timeout=15m
